title: AATIP as part of a government disclosure effort

tellings.quote: mean as recent as like 2015 16 I mean ATIP was certainly part of that effort.

plain: AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, was part of a government effort to slowly reveal what it knows about UFOs as late as 2015 and 2016. That's what Jake Barber, a guest who says he once carried a UFO with his helicopter, tells Michels, passing on what he was told by someone else. If it were true, the office would have been part of a planned release of the secret, not just a study.
